newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser says buy Elec&Eltek.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser says buy Elec&Eltek.

text.p: Fraser Securities Pte Ltd on Wednesday recommended a buy for printed circuit board (PCB) and components maker Elec & Eltek International Co Ltd (E&E).

"With the electronics industry expected to pick up by second quarter 1997, the future looks promising for E&E. This could be further strengthened should it successfully penetrate into the huge Chinese domestic market..," Fraser said in a report.
On Wednesday, E&E shares rose Singapore $0.06 at S$3.58.

Fraser said the world market for PCBs is estimated to reach some US$29 billion by the end of 1996, of which close to US$21 billion will be from the sales of double-sided and multi-layered PCBs, the two product categories E&E are engaged in.

Fraser projected E&E would post a net profit of S$55.3 million on a turnover of S$370 million for fiscal year 1997. In the year ended June 30, 1996, Fraser posted a net profit of $49.05 million on a turnover of S$311.24 million.
